subject: Request: remediation credit and sign-off options following July latency incidents
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@swiftpay.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@swiftpay.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: remediation credit and sign-off options following July latency incidents

Mina,

Thanks for taking this. Over the last two outage windows on 7/12 and 7/21 our payment flows experienced elevated tail latency which caused retries and a measurable hit to throughput. We opened a support case and your team has been responsive — appreciate that — but our finance and ops teams are asking for a remediation credit while we validate mitigations.

Quick summary attached (incident_summary_swiftpay_jul2026.pdf) and our usage/impact numbers are in the CSV. We're looking for a commercial gesture that reflects customer impact without dragging this through protracted legal negotiation. Our preferred outcome: a single credit that offsets approximately 30% of July billable spend (~$52k) or alternatively one month of service credit applied to August as a goodwill gesture.

Can you propose an options matrix we can route to procurement/finance this afternoon? We're under a vendor review next week and need a clear path to closure.

Jordan Lee
Head of Payments Ops, SwiftPay
jordan.lee@swiftpay.com

Attachments: incident_summary_swiftpay_jul2026.pdf, usage_report_swiftpay_jul2026.csv

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@swiftpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:02:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: remediation credit and sign-off options following July latency incidents

Jordan — thanks for sending the summary and CSV. I've reviewed the numbers with Ops and Finance and put together two commercial options (see attached proposed-credit-schedule.xlsx). High level:

Option A (preferred by SwiftPay ops): $52,000 one-time credit applied to July invoice + a one-month complimentary service credit for August.
Option B (alternative without exec queue): 1.5 months of service credit (prorated) valued at ~$38,000 — this can be approved by me and Karthik without escalation.

Notes/conditions: the credits are contingent on closing the RCA for the 7/12/7/21 events and agreeing to the remediation timeline in redwood-ops-remediation-plan.docx. We'd also like to schedule a short postmortem call to walk through the KV cache changes and batch sizing tweaks.

If Option A is required by SwiftPay, I need an exec sign-off (Lauren or a CRO-level approval) because it exceeds our $40k delegation. If you can confirm which option you prefer and whether procurement needs DocuSign, I will prepare the formal approval packet for signature.

Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Attachments: proposed-credit-schedule.xlsx, redwood-ops-remediation-plan.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 14:25:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: remediation credit and sign-off options following July latency incidents

Looping Lauren for visibility. Mina — thanks for the clear options. A few quick commercial points:

- Our standard approval threshold for one-off credits is $40k; anything above requires CRO (or delegated) sign-off.
- Option B ($~38k) keeps us in the fast lane (no exec meeting).
- If the customer pushes for Option A, we should attach a short release of claims and a commitment window (30 days) for remediation milestones; this reduces future exposure.

Draft approval note for Lauren: please consider approving Option A ($52k + 1 month) given the strategic nature of SwiftPay and risk of churn; alternatively approve Option B to close quickly. If approved, Mina — prepare the DocuSign packet and cc legal for the release language.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Sales — North America, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@swiftpay.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@swiftpay.com, ops@swiftpay.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 16:18:41 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: remediation credit and sign-off options following July latency incidents

Mina — appreciate the fast turnaround. Our execs prefer Option A given the operational impact and downstream chargeback risk; we'll accept the release and remediation commitments. Please route Option A for sign-off.

For timing: we need the signed agreement in procurement by EOD Friday to avoid our vendor review escalation. If DocuSign is easiest, please include the release language and proposed remediation milestones (RCA within 7 days, patch rollout within 14 days, and a 30-day joint monitoring window).

Jordan

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: SwiftPay — approval packet ready (Option A)

Karthik / Lauren — Jordan confirmed Option A and asked for DocuSign by EOD Friday. I've assembled the packet:

- Commercial addendum: $52,000 one-time credit applied to July invoice + 1 month complimentary service for August
- Release of claims paragraph (limited, mutual, 90-day window)
- Remediation milestones (RCA 7 days, mitigation 14 days, 30-day monitoring)
- Acceptance checkbox for joint monitoring and SRE contact

Attachments included in folder: proposed-credit-schedule.xlsx, redwood-ops-remediation-plan.docx. I kept the language tight to speed approval.

Requested action: Lauren — would you please sign the DocuSign approval (or delegate) so I can send to Jordan and procurement? If you'd like, here's suggested sign-off text you can paste into the e-sign: 

"I approve the proposed one-time commercial credit and service credit for SwiftPay (DEAL-4792) under the attached terms to expedite customer remediation and retention."

Thanks — Mina

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@swiftpay.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SwiftPay — approval packet ready (Option A)

Mina / Karthik / Jordan — signed. I approve the one-time $45,000 commercial credit and a one-month service credit for August, contingent on the following:

1) SwiftPay acknowledges closure of the RCA and accepts the remediation plan in redwood-ops-remediation-plan.docx.
2) We finalize and sign the release of claims (limited scope) via DocuSign today.
3) Redwood will commit a dedicated SRE contact for a 30-day joint monitoring period and provide weekly status notes.

Note: I approved $45k (slightly below $52k) to balance retention and precedent; please reflect the agreed $45,000 in the DocuSign packet and adjust invoices accordingly. Mina — please route final DocuSign link to Jordan and contracts@swiftpay.com.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

[Forwarded message included above]

Attachments referenced: proposed-credit-schedule.xlsx, redwood-ops-remediation-plan.docx
